# Record validation practice

Read the [lesson](lessons/validate.md), predict outcomes, then open the notebook through Student. The optional unaided activity is a practice protocol, not a claim of outside work.

This is an authored two-module acceptance fixture. The harness supplies the tiny video at the declared reserved HTTPS test URL; it carries no instructional content and is not a live public video. A separate candidate-only regression uses the same bytes as local media. Released Student v0.2.0 has an observed local-video authentication limitation. Source, notebook, terminal, external, HTML and Markdown surfaces are deliberate checks of the installed Student path.
